messages.subject: scale_colour, legend and expression labels
parts:
When i use expressions as labels they are right justified instead of left. Is it possible to change that behavior?
In combination with facet_grid the labels are justified to the end of the first legend entry. All further longer expressions overprint the symbol.

Thanks,
Herbert

--------
df.d <- data.frame(x=rnorm(100), y=rnorm(100), grp=rep(c(1, 2), 50))
df.d$fact_col <- factor(df.d$grp, levels=c(1,2))

groups=unique(df.d$grp)
glabels=as.character(c(expression('Controlxxxxxxxxxx'), expression('ABCD'^'-/-')))
p <- ggplot(df.d) +
        geom_point(aes(x, y, colour=fact_col)) +
        scale_colour_manual(name='', values=c('black', 'red'), guide='legend',
                breaks=groups, labels=glabels)
print(p)

glabels=c(expression('Controlxxxxxxxxxx'), expression('ABCD'^'-/-'))
q <- ggplot(df.d) +
        geom_point(aes(x, y, colour=fact_col)) +
        scale_colour_manual(name='', values=c('black', 'red'), guide='legend',
                breaks=groups, labels=glabels)
print(q)

breaks=groups, labels=glabels) +
guides(colour = guide_legend(label.hjust = 0))
print(q)
